title: CLAUDE_CODE_SCRIPT_CAPS — Per-Session Script Invocation Limits
description: New env var that caps the number of script invocations per session. Combined with CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB (already active) and PID namespace subprocess sandboxing, forms a three-layer defense for untrusted or cost-sensitive agent runs. Particularly relevant for heartbeat/cron sessions where runaway Bash loops could exhaust resources. Complements CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE (which restricts tool types, not invocation counts).

evaluation.reasoning: Novel env var that completes the subprocess sandboxing trilogy (env scrub + PID namespace + invocation cap). Directly applicable to heartbeat/cron sessions where runaway Bash loops could exhaust resources. Zero maintenance, drop-in addition to ~/.bashrc. Complements rather than duplicates CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE.
